description: Rothco’s Frontline Series Edge Pants are built for operations where adaptability, durability, and performance matter most. As part of our Frontline Series, the Edge Pants are crafted with utility-focused features that include a DWR coated four-way stretch fabric, a “knee to knee” running crotch gusset for unrestricted mobility, and a low-profile strategic design that is perfect for on and off-duty. Water-Resistant Mobility: Our Edge Pants are engineered with a water-repellent nylon / elastane performance four-way stretch fabric for a comfortable fit that moves with you. The fabric features Durable Water Repellent (DWR) coating that shields against water and outdoor debris. Comfort That Keeps Up: The tactical stretch pants feature a flexible waistband for a perfect fit, every time and anywhere. The “knee to knee” running crotch gusset offers greater range of motion and reduced stress on the seams, allowing you to move comfortably during emergencies and demanding situations. Low-Profile Utility: The plainclothes duty pants come equipped with 12 utility pockets: dual zippered low-profile cargo pockets with 2 inner firearm mag pockets, dual drop-in cell phone pockets, dual vertical “L” style front pockets with reinforced knife dock edges, and dual drop-in back pockets for duty gear, tactical equipment, and EDC essentials. Uniform-Ready Design: These low-profile tactical cargo pants feature duty belt sized double-stitched 2.25-inch-wide belt loops, with dual badge holder tabs at the front for easy access and clear identification. These uniform pants come standard with Prym snaps, YKK zipper fly, and cargo pocket closures. The New Standard: As part of Rothco’s Frontline Series, the Edge Pants redefine tactical readiness with a premium build that meets the demands of real-world conditions experienced by police officers, first responders, public safety, security guards, outdoor operators, and explorers.
